title: Naturality of the specified common-field tensor component
statement:
theorem completedTensorCommonComponent_naturality
    (symmetry : @SymmetricCategory _ _ closed.monoidal)
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    {P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X ×
      generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    (((ordinary l X R).prod (ordinary l X R)) ⋙ closed.tensor).map f ≫
        (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N Q.1 Q.2).hom =
      (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N P.1 P.2).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X ⋙ ordinary l X R).map f

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: At a fixed field, paste the naturality squares of R.integral, N.ordinary, the normalized completion comparison, and the integral-to-rational tensor identification. The rational tensor generator formula supplies the last square on integral morphisms. Naturality extends by additivity and cancellation of invertible denominator powers to every localized morphism.

For a coefficient inclusion, choose good K-flat representatives. Apply the representative equations of the two finite models, replace the completion comparisons by their normalized cochain representatives, and cancel the invertible universal counits. The balance_sections equations identify the resulting maps on all homogeneous pure tensor sections. Tensor generators, local sheafification, and totalization coproduct injections detect their equality. Descend and transport along the good-model isomorphisms; R.common_field identifies the outer comparison maps with the actual common-stage transports.

Represent both input arrows at a finite field containing the four endpoint fields. Use the coefficient compatibility squares to rewrite the explicit components there. The normalized stageTensor inclusion formula and the representative formula for commonStageDerivedTensor reduces the result to fixed-field naturality. Cancel endpoint transports. This proves the displayed equality for the constructed maps, without assuming any tensorator exists.
